source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: VT may show ventricular fusion; fusion and capture are distinct phenomena.
invariants: One P source, one ventricular electrical event and one mechanical event at selected beat
Only selected beat QRS/T replaced, no full VT retained underneath
Electrode mixing retains limb projection; both demos share source
Mechanical timing and fixed ejection inputs unchanged; no doubled perfusion
limitations: Authored discrete mixture, not propagation, AV nodal conduction, refractory or anatomical model
Fraction does not calibrate recruited myocardial mass or stroke volume
Optional fixed capture with changed RR/ejection schedule is documented in vt-capture.json
Polymorphic VT, TdP, onset/termination and other physiology gaps remain
